purpose: Element fidelity. One authored, reviewable, VERSIONED checklist per prompt: the concrete elements the prompt specifies, each verifiable from the render alone. Authored rather than LLM-decomposed per run (TIFA/DSG generate questions at eval time, which makes a score irreproducible and unreviewable); these are written once, read by a human once, and then scored identically forever.

item_kinds.ocr: a literal string the prompt requires to be READABLE in the image. Scored by OCR: exact match, plus a normalized similarity for partial credit. `absent: true` inverts it (the string must NOT be readable).
item_kinds.vqa: a closed yes/no question a judge VLM answers about the image. Phrased so YES means the prompt was obeyed.

edit_semantics.change: INSTRUCTION COMPLIANCE — did the requested edit happen, exactly as specified. Judged on the BEFORE+AFTER pair together with the instruction; a question like 'did X change' is unanswerable from the after image alone.
edit_semantics.preserve: PRESERVATION — did everything the instruction did NOT mention stay the same. Under-editing shows up as compliance failure; over-editing shows up as preservation failure.
